notice: Design contracts, not compiled tests. No future case counts as PASS or XFAIL until a concrete syntax and oracle are implemented.

tests.arrange: Create two references to one initialized object
tests.action: Mutate through each reference in source order
tests.expect: Both observe the final value; no unconditional noalias.

tests.arrange: Keep an alias, destroy its owner
tests.action: Dereference the alias
tests.expect: Static rejection when evident; otherwise a checked lifetime trap before any object load.

tests.arrange: Keep a stale alias and force reuse of its descriptor slot and address
tests.action: Dereference the old alias
tests.expect: Generation mismatch; never observe replacement data.

tests.arrange: Use a test allocator with a two-bit generation counter
tests.action: Repeatedly allocate/free a reused slot through counter exhaustion
tests.expect: Retire the slot or fail allocation; never wrap into a live stale identity.

tests.arrange: Keep a reference after its object and arena are destroyed
tests.action: Validate the reference
tests.expect: No access to reclaimed descriptor memory; clean rejection/trap.

tests.arrange: Hold references to one live and one removed object
tests.action: Acquire optional scoped access to each
tests.expect: Some for live, None for removed; acquisition protects the entire access interval.

tests.arrange: Obtain a reference to an array/subobject
tests.action: Advance within its permitted extent, to one-past, then dereference one-past
tests.expect: In-range operations succeed; one-past dereference fails.

tests.arrange: Obtain a one-element reference
tests.action: Compute an offset whose byte multiplication overflows
tests.expect: Trap/reject before address arithmetic can wrap.

tests.arrange: Create an array and nested slices
tests.action: Try negative, reversed, oversized, and valid empty ranges
tests.expect: Invalid ranges fail at construction; valid zero-length views remain usable as empty views.

tests.arrange: Prepare bytes with invalid alignment or invalid enum/bool representation
tests.action: Attempt safe typed access
tests.expect: Reject unsafe conversion or validate before exposing the typed value.

tests.arrange: Create one owner and a nonowning alias
tests.action: Move the owner, then try to use the old owning variable
tests.expect: Old owner rejected; alias remains valid if storage identity did not change.

tests.arrange: Create an owning value with nested allocations
tests.action: Copy the owner and explicitly clone it
tests.expect: Implicit owner copy rejected; explicit clone independent and its allocations reported.

tests.arrange: Nest owners and defer statements
tests.action: Exit via return, break, continue, and error propagation
tests.expect: Every resource released exactly once in documented order; no cleanup promise after process abort.

tests.arrange: Take a local address and wrap it in nested aggregates
tests.action: Return/store it outside its lifetime
tests.expect: Reject with escape origin and lifetime end; no implicit heap promotion.

tests.arrange: Create parent/child and self-reference cycles within one arena
tests.action: Mutate, traverse, then destroy the arena
tests.expect: Traversal works; ownership cycles do not retain allocations; all external refs invalidated.

tests.arrange: Create refs to two arena objects
tests.action: Remove one object
tests.expect: Removed refs become stale; unaffected refs remain valid.

tests.arrange: Use an allocator that fails after a fixed budget
tests.action: Allocate an initialized object or clone
tests.expect: Explicit failure value; no exposed uninitialized object; no leaks/double drops.

tests.arrange: Enter a stable scope with multiple aliases
tests.action: Update ordinary fields and follow graph edges
tests.expect: Allowed; mutation order preserved; lifetime checks may be eliminated only after validation.

tests.arrange: Enter a stable scope
tests.action: Free, relocate, remove, resize, or destroy protected storage
tests.expect: Reject statically or trap at the invalidating operation before storage changes.

tests.arrange: Enter a stable scope and call a callback with another alias
tests.action: Callback destroys the protected object
tests.expect: Transitive guard prevents invalidation; entry-only checking is insufficient.

tests.arrange: Keep a temporary validated access
tests.action: Suspend and allow another task to invalidate storage
tests.expect: Disallow spanning the suspension or re-establish validity safely on resume.

tests.arrange: Bind a reference into a union payload
tests.action: Switch active variant or destroy an owned field
tests.expect: Invalidate dependent access or reject; allocation-address stability is insufficient.

tests.arrange: Read through a pointer in a side-effect-free function
tests.action: Compile and optimize calls around changes to the pointee
tests.expect: Reads are reflected in effects; no memory(none) assertion.

tests.arrange: Declare a function pure
tests.action: Write through an alias/global or call an impure function
tests.expect: Reject with a transitive effect trace.

tests.arrange: Declare a no-allocation boundary
tests.action: Call through a helper/generic that allocates
tests.expect: Reject; an optimizer accidentally removing one allocation is not a source-level proof.

tests.arrange: Pass a stack reference to a non-escaping parameter
tests.action: Store it globally or in a coroutine frame
tests.expect: Reject transitive retention; ordinary non-escaping use succeeds.

tests.arrange: Take element and slice views into a vector
tests.action: Force growth/compaction/removal
tests.expect: Invalidate affected views or reject under stability; document logical identity policy.

tests.arrange: Split a slice at each endpoint and an interior point
tests.action: Mutate both results, then attempt an overlapping exclusive split
tests.expect: Disjoint operations work; exclusive overlap cannot be forged; noalias only on proven paths.

tests.arrange: Create a mutable region
tests.action: Send a raw mutable reference to another thread
tests.expect: Reject without an eligible transfer or shared-region protocol.

tests.arrange: Create a self-contained transferable owner
tests.action: Send it through a channel and access from sender afterward
tests.expect: Sender loses ownership; receiver acquires it; external aliases cannot bypass confinement.

tests.arrange: Acquire read/write access through a shared-region lock
tests.action: Unlock, then use an escaped access; concurrently remove an object
tests.expect: Escaped access rejected; lifetime protection and synchronization both enforced.

tests.arrange: Create producers with owned resources and a blocked consumer
tests.action: Cancel on empty/full channels at every suspension point
tests.expect: No lost/double-owned messages, leaked frames, or duplicate cleanup.

tests.arrange: Create optional live/absent values
tests.action: Match without the absent case
tests.expect: Compile-time exhaustiveness diagnostic.

tests.arrange: Build three helper calls returning distinct success/error payloads
tests.action: Propagate success and every failure path
tests.expect: Typed return contracts preserved across functions without stack unwinding.

tests.arrange: Allocate resources before a propagating call
tests.action: Return an error through several scopes
tests.expect: LIFO cleanup exactly once; no resource leak; payload preserved.

tests.arrange: Create runtime signed values at MIN/MAX
tests.action: Add/subtract/multiply beyond range at O0/O2/O3
tests.expect: Same checked failure semantics at every optimization level.

tests.arrange: Use signed and unsigned extrema
tests.action: Apply explicit wrapping/saturating operations
tests.expect: Matches arbitrary-precision modular/clamped oracle for every width.

tests.arrange: Prepare zero divisor, MIN/-1 and oversized/negative shift counts
tests.action: Evaluate each operation
tests.expect: Defined checked behavior; never LLVM poison or accidental hardware signal.

tests.arrange: Prepare narrowing integer and finite/NaN/infinite/out-of-range floats
tests.action: Convert through checked and explicitly lossy APIs
tests.expect: Result/failure follows the specification at representational boundaries.

tests.arrange: Compute count * element_size near integer limits
tests.action: Allocate or construct a slice
tests.expect: Overflow fails before allocation; no undersized allocation with oversized view.

tests.arrange: Prepare multibyte characters, embedded NUL, and invalid UTF-8
tests.action: Construct str and bytes, index bytes, iterate characters
tests.expect: UTF-8 validity enforced for str; arbitrary bytes allowed; byte/character counts distinct.

tests.arrange: Make a view into an owning string
tests.action: Move owner, grow buffer, then drop owner
tests.expect: Views follow documented invalidation; no implicit deep copies.

tests.arrange: Take a non-terminated substring and text containing NUL
tests.action: Pass through safe C-string conversion
tests.expect: Termination/lifetime guaranteed or explicit failure; any allocation visible.

tests.arrange: Construct raw integers, mismatched pointers and forged extents
tests.action: Dereference or transmute in safe code
tests.expect: Reject; unsafe entry is visible and auditable.

tests.arrange: Export structs, scalars, safe references and C-compatible buffers
tests.action: Call in both directions through a compiled C fixture
tests.expect: Explicit ABI and widths verified; safe pointer metadata never silently discarded.

tests.arrange: Pass a scoped buffer to C that retains it or calls back
tests.action: Return to Kawa and attempt deferred access
tests.expect: Wrapper must establish a valid ownership/lifetime contract; annotations alone are insufficient.

tests.arrange: Instantiate static matrices with compatible/incompatible dimensions
tests.action: Multiply, transpose, and index multidimensional views
tests.expect: Static shape errors rejected; dynamic shapes checked before writes.

tests.arrange: Prepare disjoint and overlapping input/output matrices
tests.action: Call destination-based matmul
tests.expect: Documented overlap policy enforced; result matches independent oracle.

tests.arrange: Prepare large dynamic matrices
tests.action: Evaluate chained operations under a noalloc boundary
tests.expect: Allocation explicit or rejected; output/temp byte counters match actual execution.

tests.arrange: Use cancellation-sensitive values, signed zero, NaN and infinity
tests.action: Enable contraction/reassociation/finite assumptions separately
tests.expect: Strict mode matches its rounding contract; each permission affects only its declared scope.

tests.arrange: Prepare complex zero, unit, conjugate pairs, and extreme magnitudes
tests.action: Perform add/multiply/divide/conjugate
tests.expect: Library implementation matches high-precision oracle within specified tolerance.

tests.arrange: Prepare valid syntax variants and invalid syntax
tests.action: Format twice and parse again
tests.expect: Idempotent canonical output; valid semantics preserved; invalid input reported, not silently blessed.

tests.arrange: Prepare errors at UTF-8 spans and across imports
tests.action: Request text/JSON/explain output
tests.expect: Stable codes, valid JSON, correct source spans and nonzero exit on error.

tests.arrange: Prepare valid and invalid multi-module programs
tests.action: Run check without a linker
tests.expect: No machine-code artifacts or runtime execution; correct exit status.

tests.arrange: Build identical inputs in clean workspaces with normalized paths
tests.action: Repeat using the same pinned toolchain/settings
tests.expect: Identical declared artifacts; all nondeterministic fields accounted for.

tests.arrange: Prepare removable/retained bounds, lifetime checks and allocations
tests.action: Request optimization explanation
tests.expect: Reports agree with emitted IR and instrumentation, including why a check remains.
